answer: Because the timing is entered against the onyx challenge, the canyon audit can replay the willow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 25 submissions and hold every identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1784 identities would post 1202 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
